xszq1u:256: The MCP protocol standardizes "how to integrate tools," but never answers "which tools are trustworthy and who approves them." When organizations adopt MCP at scale, the same demand keeps recurring: teams need a trusted list of MCP servers, one that must include internally built servers. Custom Catalogs is precisely the response to this structural gap—platform teams package approved servers (official Catalog + community sources + self-built) into a publishable catalog entity, allowing developers to centrally discover trusted tools within organizational boundaries without understanding the internal approval process.
